item.title: Morning News Brief
item.description: Three people were killed in a shooting at a Seattle food festival Sunday. The U.S. and Iran pause airstrikes, with less than 100 days until Election Day.

item.title: Baltimore Will Transform 911 Into More Than Just an Emergency Number
item.description: Baltimore is rethinking what it means to call 911 and who responds. Callers who don't need police will get help finding social services and healthcare.

item.title: France battles ongoing wildfires as Spain makes progress
item.description: A wildfire in southern France's Gironde region remains active, while two major fires in central Spain are being brought under control.

item.title: Kalshi challenges Wisconsin law banning election bets as 'voter suppression'
item.description: The dispute between a leading prediction market firm and a key battleground state may foreshadow future conflicts between states and the industry.
